form.notes_placeholder: Optional notes about this inventory item...
form.product_info: The product this inventory item represents. Cannot be changed after creation.
form.sku_info: Stock Keeping Unit — a unique identifier for this item at this location.
form.on_hand_info: Total quantity physically present at this location, including reserved units.
form.reserved_info: Quantity set aside for pending orders. Deducted from available stock.
form.reorder_level_info: When on-hand stock drops to or below this level, a restock alert is triggered.
form.unit_of_measure_info: The unit used to count this item (e.g. pcs, kg, box).
form.notes_info: Internal notes visible only to staff. Not shown to customers.

serial.title: Serial Numbers
serial.serial_number_info: Unique identifier printed on the physical unit.
serial.imei_info: 15-digit IMEI for mobile or wireless devices. Leave blank if not applicable.
serial.status_info: Current lifecycle state of this unit (available, sold, reserved, defective, returned).
serial.warranty_start_info: Date the manufacturer warranty begins for this unit.
serial.warranty_end_info: Date the manufacturer warranty expires for this unit.
serial.purchase_order_info: The purchase order this unit was received against.
serial.sold_reference_info: The sale or invoice reference when this unit was sold.

transaction.title: Transactions
transaction.type_info: The kind of stock movement being recorded.
transaction.quantity_info: Number of units affected. Use a positive value.
transaction.date_info: Date when the movement actually occurred.
transaction.reference_info: Optional reference number (e.g. PO number, sale ID) for traceability.

depreciation.title: Depreciation
depreciation.method_info: Accounting method used to spread the asset's cost over its useful life.
depreciation.cost_basis_info: Original purchase cost of the asset in centavos (÷100 for display).
depreciation.salvage_value_info: Estimated residual value at end of useful life, in centavos.
depreciation.useful_life_info: Expected lifespan of the asset in months.
depreciation.start_date_info: Date depreciation calculation begins (typically the acquisition date).
